# CWE-798: Generic API key — 32+ hex/base64 assigned to api_key.
# Keys like "1234..." or high-entropy strings are flagged when bound to
# api_key. The rule tests entropy and assignment; ok is "short" (too
# low entropy) or unrelated variable names.
# ruleid: detected-generic-api-key
api_key="12345678901234567890123456789012"
# ruleid: detected-generic-api-key
API_KEY=AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz1234567890
# ruleid: detected-generic-api-key
api_key="abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcd"
# ruleid: detected-generic-api-key
API_KEY="99887766554433221100aabbccddeeff"
# ok: detected-generic-api-key
api_key = "short"
# ok: detected-generic-api-key
not_api_key = "123"
# ok: detected-generic-api-key
api_key = "example_placeholder_low_entropy"
